as_told.title: Immaculate Constellation report: triangle ARVs over Indo-PACOM

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb points to a document called Immaculate Constellation, which he links to a man named Matthew Brown. He says it describes slowly rotating triangles seen in 2017 over the area of Indo-Pacific Command, the US military command covering the Pacific and Indian Ocean region. If true, the military would have recorded strange triangular craft in its own operating areas.
